messages.content: Greetings, I am Amy, an NLP researcher from Boston. I firmly maintain that Natural Language Processing has exerted a net positive influence on the world. This technology has significantly enhanced the efficacy of search engines and digital assistants in comprehending human language, while also facilitating major breakthroughs in machine translation that increase information accessibility across language barriers. As a researcher, I am dedicated to advancing these technologies for continued global benefit.
